runtimeMapping.attacks: Single ground WALK target; ordinary/S1 Attack .467, S2 Skill_2_Loop .300/.567 distinct OnAttack events retaining one input target, S3 Skill_3_Loop .667; positive animation speed capped at1. CAST reselects legal targets and S1 refunds only a dead original input with no legal replacement.
runtimeMapping.s2: Cast on locate starts selected duration/ATK and talent_scale. Born uses original Start_2; mode1 uses Skill_2_Idle/Loop, then original .167 End before ordinary Idle.
runtimeMapping.s3: Source allows abnormal-state casting. At activation check source-resistable flags/buffs, apply600 current-mitigated Arts to self before cleanse, then derived anti flags and MAX_HP. Self-hit can kill and does not grant hurt SP; it can trigger the ordinary damage-receipt talent. Existing RESIST_STATUSES catalogue is deliberately not the native immunity mask.
runtimeMapping.status: Native DB abnormalAntis STUNNED/COLD/FROZEN reject matching incoming raw flags; ANTI_STATUS_RESISTABLE rejects sourceStatusResistable YES descriptors. Automatic resistance identity follows those three flags; NO skips the status-resistable branch; literal anti flags still apply. Fear is YES in the pinned database. Arbitrary slow/sleep/silence/debuff effects are not guessed resistant. Derived immunity ends with S3.
runtimeMapping.damage: Talent1 selected Phys/Arts nonstack reduction requires owner currently blocking and source not blocked by owner; S2 scales the reduction. Talent2 accepted damage creates/extends one selected ATK buff for15s; HPLOSS bypasses the receipt. S3 selected damage multiplier checks whether the target is blocked by any ally, at emission.

verificationLimits: Native C# mode/event dispatcher is not executable here. Begin/End visual transitions use original clip duration; source events are scheduled by the fixed-step simulator, with no in-game frame parity claim.

Native AUTO statusResistable classification is mapped to the recovered STUNNED/COLD/FROZEN mask; explicit YES/NO descriptors are preserved. Producer-specific debuffs not yet carrying source metadata remain unsupported, rather than inferred from the broader legacy Resist catalogue.

CreateBuffById anti lifetimes have duration keys absent from the selected skill blackboard; derived-parent ownership is simulated through S3 end. Native missing-key lifetime resolution and same-frame parent/child callback order remain unverified.

MAX_HP starts after self-hit and cleanse; the common engine preserves currentHP ratio on MAX_HP expansion/contraction. Native HP correction/rounding, acquisition ties and arbitrary external cancellation priorities remain unverified.
Native Unity particle, audio, hit and skill effects are retained as references but not rendered. Modules and unreviewed cross-operator/event effects are not enabled.
